CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 6, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 9:00 AM

Erik Frost Hollins, President  Joen Garnica, Commissioner
Robyn Gordon-Peterson, Vice President  Victoria Love, Commissioner
  Jose Osuna, Commissioner

Christina Pizarro Winting, Executive Director

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 9:18 AM, President Frost Hollins called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Garnica, Love, Osuna, Gordon-Peterson, Frost Hollins

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 John Davis, Assistant Fire Chief, led the Pledge of Allegiance.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 There were no comments from the public.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-52436  Recommendation to discuss and possible action on the proposed Charter
  Amendment for Civil Service reform.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Osuna, seconded by Vice
  President Gordon-Peterson, to approve recommendation. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Garnica, Love, Osuna, Gordon-Peterson, Frost Hollins
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Commissioner Garnica spoke.

  Page 1 of 3
   CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 6, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 9:00 AM

  President Frost Hollins spoke.

  Commissioner Osuna spoke.

  Commissioner Garnica spoke.

  Vice President Gordon-Peterson spoke.

  Commissioner Love spoke.

  President Frost Hollins spoke.

  Commissioner Osuna spoke.

  Commissioner Garnica spoke.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Herman Long spoke.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Commissioner Garnica thanked Civil Service staff.

Commissioner Osuna wanted to honor National Women’s History Month.

ADJOURNMENT

At 10:34 AM, there being no objection, President Frost Hollins declared the meeting adjourned.
